from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class FirstHook(BaseModel):
    run: Callable[[int], int] = Field(
        ..., json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[int], int]'}, title='Run'
    )


class SecondHook(BaseModel):
    stop: Callable[[str], str] = Field(
        ..., json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[str], str]'}, title='Stop'
    )


class Both(BaseModel):
    first: FirstHook
    second: SecondHook
